en.headline: Man dies after being pulled from the sea at Western Harbourfront
en.dek: A man in his forties was found floating near the piers opposite the Western Wholesale Food Market early Wednesday and later died in hospital, police said.
body: Police said a passer-by reported seeing a man floating in the water off the Central and Western District waterfront near Fung Mat Road in Kennedy Town around 7:40am on Wednesday.

Firefighters and other rescue personnel retrieved the man, described in reports as being in his forties and of South Asian descent, from the sea between the second and third piers opposite the Western Wholesale Food Market. He was unconscious when brought ashore and was taken to Queen Mary Hospital.

Hospital staff confirmed he died after resuscitation efforts. Police are investigating the man's identity and the circumstances of the incident. No further details on the cause were immediately available.

zh.headline: 西環海濱長廊男子墮海 送院搶救不治
zh.dek: 一名年約四十歲南亞裔男子今早在西區副食品批發市場對開海面被發現載浮載沉，獲救後送瑪麗醫院，惜不治。
body: 警方表示，周三早上約七時四十分，有途人報案指堅尼地城豐物道西區副食品批發市場對開海面有男子載浮載沉。
救援人員在海濱長廊對開二號至三號碼頭之間將該名年約四十歲的南亞裔男子救起，當時他已昏迷，隨即由救護車送往瑪麗醫院搶救。
院方其後證實他經搶救後不治。警方正調查死者身份及墮海原因，事件詳情仍在跟進中。
